item.title: 👀 GitHub thinks it's fixed and is watching nervously
item.description:
Disruption with some GitHub services

Impact: minor · Status: monitoring · Opened: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 17:06:26 +0000

Starting around 18:02 UTC on November 5, GitHub web sessions stopped being renewed based on recent activity, so users were signed out when their sessions expired due to inactivity. These sign-outs were caused by a bug in session renewal, not due to a security incident. We believe we fixed the bug at 05:23 UTC on November 19, and sessions created since then should renew as usual. We’re continuing to monitor the situation. If you had an inactive session from that period, you may still find that you’re signed out when you return to GitHub. If that happens, all you need to do is sign back in.
